quote: We cast this task as a special case of multi-aspect document summarization

We introduce a new clinical natural language processing task that accomplishes focused information extraction from intensive care unit (ICU) discharge notes by selecting sentences that contain action items for PCPs or patients.
outputs: Extracted sentences containing action items for PCPs
The output is a set of sentences from discharge notes that contain action items, classified into one or more of seven label types (e.g., Appointments, Medications, Lab tests).

quote: We report results on the test set using micro- and macro-averaged metrics common in multi-label classification, and F1 for the binary reduction of the task.
We report results on the test set using micro- and macro-averaged metrics common in multilabel classification, and F1 for the binary reduction of the task.
We estimated inter-rater reliability by having two physician annotators independently annotate a set of 13 documents comprising 2600 sentences.
guideline: The full annotation guidelines were refined through multiple rounds of calibration, discussion of disagreements, and updates to rules and examples; they are available in the public repository.
